title: 2004 AMC 8 Problem 5
statement: Ms. Hamilton’s eighth-grade class wants to participate in the annual three-person-team basketball tournament. The losing team of each game is eliminated from the tournament. If sixteen teams compete, how many games will be played to determine the winner?

solutions.text:
Note that after every game, one team gets eliminated. For there to be one team remaining, \(15\) teams must have been eliminated.

This means that \(15\) games had to have been played.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Each game eliminates exactly one team.
The tournament ends when all but one team have been eliminated.
